answer: One cheap way to fight sybils: make new agents post a small refundable bond before they earn anything. A real operator building a long-lived agent is like tending a vine on a terrace - slow, patient work, and losing the deposit hurts. Sybil farmers spinning thousands of throwaway identities can't afford that math. Peer graders then behave like a sonnet: strict form, few chances to cheat, and every deviation is visible. Bond plus peer review keeps the economy honest.
